name: Wonder Payment For WooCommerce
author: wonderpayment

sections.description:
Shifting consumer expectations have driven demand for seamless, versatile payment solutions—and while great checkout experiences boost user satisfaction and streamline operations, managing complex payment workflows can distract businesses from core priorities. Wonder Payment delivers exceptional consumer payment experiences through stable, fast and diversified collection methods, freeing you from granular payment‑related tasks to focus fully on your business logic. We offer more than 37 payment options for your selection and use.

Wonder Payment supports fully automated eKYC procedures, with onboarding completed in as little as 7 minutes, eliminating cumbersome manual processes. This is the official plugin created by Wonder.

Optimize your revenue with Wonder Payment:

  • Experience Optimized: Gain experience‑optimized solutions across desktop, tablet, mobile and other devices to cover full‑scenario payment requirements.
  • Diversified Payment Methods: One‑click integration of over 37 payment methods, including Apple Pay, Google Pay, Visa, Mastercard, UnionPay, WeChat Pay, Alipay, FPS, Octopus and more, to cater to broader consumer demands.
  • Card Tokenisation: Consumers can link their card details on‑web for one‑click future payments, streamlining the checkout experience for repeat purchases.
  • Fraud Prevention: Wonder Payment’s risk control team updates its machine‑learning‑powered risk engine in real time to flag potential fraudulent transactions.
  • In‑Person Payment Acceptance: Beyond online payments, Wonder SoftPOS enables offline collection via standard mobile devices, with professional Wonder mPOS hardware also available for your use.
  • Security: Wonder Payment solutions are fully PCI‑DSS compliant.

Compatibility Notes

1.0.5

1.0.4
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/wonder-payment-for-woocommerce directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments
  4. Find “Wonder Payments” and click “Manage”
  5. Follow the setup wizard to configure your payment gateway
sections.faq:
Do I need to pay to integrate Wonder Payment?

No. There is no cost for integration. After installing the plugin, simply scan the QR code via your Wonder App to complete automatic configuration.

Does this require an SSL certificate?

Yes. In Live Mode, an SSL certificate must be installed on your site to use Wonder Payment.

Does this support both production mode and sandbox mode for testing?

Yes, it does. Both production and test (sandbox) modes are driven by the API keys you use with a checkbox in the admin settings to toggle between both.

Where can I find documentation?

Visit our regularly updated online help site:Wonder Help
